authorized_domains.Description: List of domains authorized for OAuth redirects.

autodelete_anonymous_users.Description: Whether anonymous users will be auto-deleted after a period of 30 days

forward_inbound_credentials.Description: The user credentials to include in the JWT payload that is sent to the registered Blocking Functions.

access_token.Description: Whether to pass the user's OAuth identity provider's access token.

id_token.Description: Whether to pass the user's OIDC identity provider's ID token.

refresh_token.Description: Whether to pass the user's OAuth identity provider's refresh token.

triggers.Description: Map of Trigger to event type. Key should be one of the supported event types: "beforeCreate", "beforeSignIn".

function_uri.Description: HTTP URI trigger for the Cloud Function.

name.Description: The name of the Config resource

sign_up_quota_config.Description: Quota for the Signup endpoint, if overwritten. Signup quota is measured in sign ups per project per hour per IP.

quota.Description: A sign up APIs quota that customers can override temporarily.

quota_duration.Description: How long this quota will be active for. It is measurred in seconds, e.g., Example: "9.615s".

start_time.Description: When this quota will take affect.

sign_in.Description: Configuration related to local sign in methods.

allow_duplicate_emails.Description: Whether to allow more than one account to have the same email.

anonymous.Description: Configuration options related to authenticating an anonymous user.

enabled.Description: Whether anonymous user auth is enabled for the project or not.

email.Description: Configuration options related to authenticating a user by their email address.

enabled.Description: Whether email auth is enabled for the project or not.

password_required.Description:
Whether a password is required for email auth or not. If true, both an email and
password must be provided to sign in. If false, a user may sign in via either
email/password or email link.

algorithm.Description: Different password hash algorithms used in Identity Toolkit.

memory_cost.Description: Memory cost for hash calculation. Used by scrypt and other similar password derivation algorithms. See https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7914 for explanation of field.

rounds.Description: How many rounds for hash calculation. Used by scrypt and other similar password derivation algorithms.

salt_separator.Description: Non-printable character to be inserted between the salt and plain text password in base64.

phone_number.Description: Configuration options related to authenticated a user by their phone number.

enabled.Description: Whether phone number auth is enabled for the project or not.

test_phone_numbers.Description: A map of <test phone number, fake code> that can be used for phone auth testing.

sms_region_config.Description: Configures the regions where users are allowed to send verification SMS for the project or tenant. This is based on the calling code of the destination phone number.

allow_by_default.Description: A policy of allowing SMS to every region by default and adding disallowed regions to a disallow list.

disallowed_regions.Description: Two letter unicode region codes to disallow as defined by https://cldr.unicode.org/ The full list of these region codes is here: https://github.com/unicode-cldr/cldr-localenames-full/blob/master/main/en/territories.json

allowlist_only.Description: A policy of only allowing regions by explicitly adding them to an allowlist.

allowed_regions.Description: Two letter unicode region codes to allow as defined by https://cldr.unicode.org/ The full list of these region codes is here: https://github.com/unicode-cldr/cldr-localenames-full/blob/master/main/en/territories.json
